units.action: restrict the free movement of personal data
units.scope: within the Union
units.condition: for reasons connected with the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data
units.proposition: Member States shall not restrict the free movement of personal data within the Union for reasons connected with the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data.

units.action: comply with this Regulation
units.scope: processing of personal data wholly or partly by automated means
units.exception: The Regulation does not apply if the processing is: (a) in the course of an activity falling outside the scope of Union law; (b) by the Member States when carrying out activities within the scope of Chapter 2 of Title V of the TEU; (c) by a natural person in the course of a purely personal or household activity; or (d) by competent authorities for the purposes of the prevention, investigation, detection or prosecution of criminal offences or the execution of criminal penalties, including safeguarding against and the prevention of threats to public security.
units.proposition: Controllers and processors must comply with this Regulation when they process personal data wholly or partly by automated means, except where the processing falls under the listed exclusions in points (a) to (d).

units.addressee: Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies
units.action: comply with Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 for their processing of personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies
units.proposition: Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies must comply with Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 for their processing of personal data.

units.addressee: Union legislator and relevant Union institutions responsible for amending Union legal acts
units.action: adapt Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 and other Union legal acts applicable to processing by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies to the principles and rules of this Regulation
units.scope: Union legal acts governing or applicable to processing of personal data by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies
units.condition: applicable to such processing by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies
units.proposition: The Union legislator and relevant Union institutions must adapt Regulation (EC) No 45/2001 and other Union legal acts applicable to the processing of personal data by Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies to the principles and rules of this Regulation in accordance with Article 98.

units.addressee: controller or processor with an establishment in the Union
units.action: comply with this Regulation for the processing of personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data
units.condition: the processing is in the context of the activities of an establishment of the controller or the processor in the Union, regardless of where the processing takes place
units.proposition: A controller or processor with an establishment in the Union must comply with this Regulation for any processing of personal data in the context of the activities of that establishment, regardless of where the processing takes place.

units.ru_label: Apply GDPR for non-EU offering goods or services in the Union
units.addressee: controller or processor not established in the Union
units.action: comply with this Regulation for the processing of personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data of data subjects who are in the Union
units.condition: the processing activities are related to the offering of goods or services to such data subjects in the Union, whether or not payment by the data subject is required
units.proposition: A controller or processor not established in the Union must comply with this Regulation for processing personal data of data subjects who are in the Union when the processing relates to offering goods or services to those data subjects, whether or not payment is required.

units.ru_label: Apply GDPR under Member State public international law
units.addressee: controller not established in the Union
units.action: comply with this Regulation for the processing of personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data
units.condition: the controller is in a place where Member State law applies by virtue of public international law
units.proposition: A controller not established in the Union must comply with this Regulation for processing personal data when the controller is in a place where Member State law applies by virtue of public international law.

units.action: process those personal data in compliance with the applicable data protection rules according to the purposes of the processing
units.scope: processing of personal data received in the framework of a particular inquiry
units.condition: they receive personal data in the framework of a particular inquiry in accordance with Union or Member State law
units.proposition: Public authorities that receive personal data in the framework of a particular inquiry in accordance with Union or Member State law must process those data in compliance with the applicable data protection rules according to the purposes of the processing.

units.action: provide for the controller or the specific criteria for its nomination
units.scope: designation of the controller or the specific criteria for its nomination
units.condition: the purposes and means of the processing of personal data are determined by Union or Member State law
units.proposition: Where the purposes and means of processing are determined by Union or Member State law, the Union or Member State legislator has the power to provide for the controller or the specific criteria for its nomination.

units.addressee: supervisory authority of the Member State concerned
units.action: act as the competent supervisory authority for the processing operations
units.scope: the Member State concerned
units.condition: processing is carried out by public authorities or private bodies acting on the basis of Article 6(1)(c) or (e)
units.proposition: The supervisory authority of the Member State concerned has the power to act as the competent supervisory authority where processing is carried out by public authorities or private bodies acting on the basis of Article 6(1)(c) or (e).

units.action: apply the lead supervisory authority mechanism under Article 56
units.condition: processing is carried out by public authorities or private bodies acting on the basis of Article 6(1)(c) or (e)
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are prohibited from applying the Article 56 lead supervisory authority mechanism in cases where processing is carried out by public authorities or private bodies acting on the basis of Article 6(1)(c) or (e).

units.ru_label: No SA competence over courts in judicial capacity
units.action: supervise processing operations
units.scope: processing operations of courts acting in their judicial capacity
units.proposition: Supervisory authorities are prohibited from supervising processing operations of courts acting in their judicial capacity.

units.action: be able to demonstrate that the data subject has consented to the processing of their personal data
units.scope: processing of personal data based on consent
units.condition: Where processing is based on consent
units.proposition: Where processing is based on consent, the controller is obliged to be able to demonstrate that the data subject has consented to the processing of their personal data.

units.action: present the request for consent in a manner clearly distinguishable from other matters
units.scope: written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.condition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.proposition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters, the controller is obliged to present the request for consent in a manner clearly distinguishable from those other matters.

units.action: present the request for consent in an intelligible and easily accessible form
units.scope: written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.condition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters
units.proposition: If consent is sought within a written declaration that also concerns other matters, the controller is obliged to present the request for consent in an intelligible and easily accessible form.

units.ru_label: Inform other controllers of erasure request
units.action: take reasonable steps to inform controllers processing the personal data that the data subject has requested those controllers erase any links to, or copies or replications of, the personal data
units.scope: taking account of available technology and the cost of implementation; steps may include technical measures
units.condition: the controller has made the personal data public and is obliged under paragraph 1 to erase the personal data
units.exception: Paragraphs 1 and 2 do not apply to the extent that processing is necessary for: (a) exercising the right of freedom of expression and information; (b) compliance with a legal obligation under Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject or performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller; (c) reasons of public interest in the area of public health in accordance with Article 9(2)(h) and (i) and Article 9(3); (d) archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes in accordance with Article 89(1), insofar as the right in paragraph 1 would render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing; (e) the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims
units.proposition: Where a controller has made personal data public and is obliged under paragraph 1 to erase them, the controller must, taking account of available technology and cost, take reasonable steps (including technical measures) to inform controllers processing the data that the data subject has requested those controllers erase any links to, or copies or replications of, the personal data.

units.ru_label: Exception to para 2 duty when necessary processing
units.action: refrain from taking the steps in paragraph 2 to inform other controllers
units.condition: processing is necessary for: (a) exercising the right of freedom of expression and information; (b) compliance with a legal obligation under Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject or performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller; (c) reasons of public interest in the area of public health in accordance with Article 9(2)(h) and (i) and Article 9(3); (d) archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes in accordance with Article 89(1), insofar as the right in paragraph 1 would render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing; (e) the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims
units.proposition: A controller may refrain from taking the steps in paragraph 2 to inform other controllers when processing is necessary for the grounds listed in points (a) to (e) of paragraph 3.

units.ru_label: Exception to para 1 erasure duty when necessary processing
units.action: refrain from erasing personal data under paragraph 1
units.condition: processing is necessary for: (a) exercising the right of freedom of expression and information; (b) compliance with a legal obligation under Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject or performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller; (c) reasons of public interest in the area of public health in accordance with Article 9(2)(h) and (i) and Article 9(3); (d) archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes in accordance with Article 89(1), insofar as the right in paragraph 1 would render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing; (e) the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims
units.proposition: A controller may refrain from erasing personal data under paragraph 1 when processing is necessary for the grounds listed in points (a) to (e) of paragraph 3.

units.action: process personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures
units.scope: personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures
units.condition: the processing is based on Article 6(1) GDPR
units.exception: when the processing is under the control of official authority; or when the processing is authorised by Union or Member State law that provides appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of data subjects
units.proposition: A controller is prohibited from processing personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures on an Article 6(1) basis, except under the control of official authority or when authorised by Union or Member State law that provides appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.

units.action: provide appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of data subjects in laws that authorise processing of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures
units.scope: laws authorising processing under Article 10
units.condition: when enacting or maintaining Union or Member State law that authorises such processing
units.proposition: A Union or Member State legislator is obliged to provide appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of data subjects in any law that authorises processing of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences or related security measures.

units.ru_label: Comprehensive conviction registers under official authority only
units.action: keep a comprehensive register of criminal convictions
units.scope: comprehensive registers of criminal convictions
units.exception: unless the register is under the control of official authority
units.proposition: A controller is prohibited from keeping any comprehensive register of criminal convictions unless it is under the control of official authority.

units.action: refuse to act on a data subject's request to exercise rights
units.scope: requests to exercise rights under Articles 15 to 22
units.condition: a data subject makes a request to exercise rights under Articles 15 to 22
units.exception: the controller demonstrates it is not in a position to identify the data subject
units.proposition: The controller shall not refuse to act on a data subject's request to exercise rights under Articles 15 to 22 unless the controller demonstrates it is not in a position to identify the data subject.

units.action: provide the data subject with information on action taken on a request
units.scope: requests under Articles 15 to 22
units.condition: upon receipt of the data subject's request
units.temporal: without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of the request
units.proposition: The controller shall provide the data subject with information on action taken on a request under Articles 15 to 22 without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of the request.

units.action: extend the one-month response period by two further months
units.scope: responding to requests under Articles 15 to 22
units.condition: where necessary, taking into account the complexity and number of the requests
units.temporal: extension of up to two further months
units.proposition: The controller may extend the one-month period for responding to a request under Articles 15 to 22 by two further months where necessary, taking into account the complexity and number of the requests.

units.ru_label: Take measures to provide specified info/comms
units.action: take appropriate measures to provide to the data subject the information and communications specified
units.scope: any information referred to in Articles 13 and 14 and any communication under Articles 15 to 22 and 34 relating to processing
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to take appropriate measures to provide to the data subject the information in Articles 13 and 14 and the communications under Articles 15 to 22 and 34 relating to processing.

units.ru_label: Ensure concise transparent intelligible accessible form
units.action: ensure that the information and communications provided are in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form
units.scope: the information and communications covered by Article 12(1)
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to ensure that the information and communications provided are in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form.

units.ru_label: Use clear and plain language (incl. child-directed info)
units.action: use clear and plain language for the information and communications provided
units.scope: the information and communications covered by Article 12(1), including information addressed specifically to a child
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to use clear and plain language for the information and communications provided, including where the information is addressed specifically to a child.

units.action: provide the data subject with the identity of the controller
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the identity of the controller at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the contact details of the controller's representative
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject and the controller has a representative
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: Where the controller has a representative, the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the contact details of the controller's representative at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the contact details of the data protection officer
units.condition: where personal data relating to a data subject are collected from the data subject and provision of the data protection officer's contact details is applicable
units.exception: where and insofar as the data subject already has the information
units.temporal: at the time when personal data are obtained
units.proposition: Where applicable, the controller is obliged to provide the data subject with the contact details of the data protection officer at the time when personal data are obtained where the personal data are collected from the data subject, unless and insofar as the data subject already has the information.

units.action: provide the data subject with the identity of the controller
units.scope: information duties when personal data were not obtained from the data subject
units.condition: where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject
units.exception: Paragraphs 1 to 4 do not apply where and insofar as: (a) the data subject already has the information; (b) providing the information proves impossible or would involve a disproportionate effort, in particular for processing for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes, subject to Article 89(1), or insofar as the obligation in paragraph 1 would render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing; (c) obtaining or disclosure is expressly laid down by Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject and which provides appropriate measures to protect the data subject's legitimate interests; or (d) the personal data must remain confidential subject to an obligation of professional secrecy under Union or Member State law, including a statutory obligation of secrecy.
units.proposition: Where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject, the controller shall provide the data subject with the identity of the controller.

units.action: provide the data subject with the contact details of the controller
units.scope: information duties when personal data were not obtained from the data subject
units.condition: where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject
units.exception: Paragraphs 1 to 4 do not apply where and insofar as: (a) the data subject already has the information; (b) providing the information proves impossible or would involve a disproportionate effort, in particular for processing for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes, subject to Article 89(1), or insofar as the obligation in paragraph 1 would render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing; (c) obtaining or disclosure is expressly laid down by Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject and which provides appropriate measures to protect the data subject's legitimate interests; or (d) the personal data must remain confidential subject to an obligation of professional secrecy under Union or Member State law, including a statutory obligation of secrecy.
units.proposition: Where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject, the controller shall provide the data subject with the contact details of the controller.

units.action: provide the data subject with the identity of the controller's representative
units.scope: information duties when personal data were not obtained from the data subject
units.condition: where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject and a representative is applicable
units.exception: Paragraphs 1 to 4 do not apply where and insofar as: (a) the data subject already has the information; (b) providing the information proves impossible or would involve a disproportionate effort, in particular for processing for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes, subject to Article 89(1), or insofar as the obligation in paragraph 1 would render impossible or seriously impair the achievement of the objectives of that processing; (c) obtaining or disclosure is expressly laid down by Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject and which provides appropriate measures to protect the data subject's legitimate interests; or (d) the personal data must remain confidential subject to an obligation of professional secrecy under Union or Member State law, including a statutory obligation of secrecy.
units.proposition: Where a representative is applicable and personal data were not obtained from the data subject, the controller shall provide the data subject with the identity of the controller's representative.

units.action: obtain from the controller confirmation whether personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.scope: confirmation of processing status of personal data concerning the data subject
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller confirmation whether personal data concerning them are being processed.

units.action: obtain access to personal data concerning the data subject
units.scope: personal data concerning the data subject
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain access to personal data concerning them where such personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller information on the purposes of the processing
units.scope: purposes of the processing
units.condition: where the personal data concerning the data subject are being processed
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller information on the purposes of the processing where their personal data are being processed.

units.action: obtain from the controller the rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning him or her
units.scope: inaccurate personal data concerning the data subject
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller, without undue delay, the rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning him or her.

units.action: have incomplete personal data completed, including by providing a supplementary statement
units.scope: incomplete personal data concerning the data subject
units.condition: taking into account the purposes of the processing
units.proposition: Taking into account the purposes of the processing, the data subject has the right to have incomplete personal data completed, including by providing a supplementary statement.

units.action: erase personal data concerning the data subject
units.scope: personal data concerning the data subject
units.condition: where at least one of the following grounds applies: (a) the personal data are no longer necessary in relation to the purposes for which they were collected or otherwise processed; (b) the data subject withdraws consent on which the processing is based according to point (a) of Article 6(1), or point (a) of Article 9(2), and where there is no other legal ground for the processing; (c) the data subject objects to the processing pursuant to Article 21(1) and there are no overriding legitimate grounds for the processing, or the data subject objects to the processing pursuant to Article 21(2); (d) the personal data have been unlawfully processed; (e) the personal data have to be erased for compliance with a legal obligation in Union or Member State law to which the controller is subject; (f) the personal data have been collected in relation to the offer of information society services referred to
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to erase personal data concerning the data subject, without undue delay, where at least one of the listed grounds applies.

units.action: withdraw a certification
units.scope: certifications issued pursuant to Articles 42 and 43
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to withdraw a certification issued pursuant to Articles 42 and 43.

units.ru_label: SA power order CB not to issue certification
units.action: order the certification body not to issue a certification
units.scope: certifications under Articles 42 and 43
units.condition: the requirements for the certification are not or are no longer met
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to order the certification body not to issue a certification if the requirements for the certification are not or are no longer met.

units.action: impose an administrative fine
units.scope: pursuant to Article 83, in addition to or instead of the measures referred to in paragraph 2
units.condition: depending on the circumstances of each individual case
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority has the power to impose an administrative fine pursuant to Article 83, in addition to or instead of the measures referred to in paragraph 2, depending on the circumstances of each individual case.

units.action: obtain from the controller the restriction of processing
units.scope: processing of the data subject's personal data
units.condition: the accuracy of the personal data is contested by the data subject
units.temporal: for a period enabling the controller to verify the accuracy of the personal data
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the restriction of processing of their personal data when the accuracy of the personal data is contested, for a period enabling the controller to verify the accuracy.

units.action: obtain from the controller the restriction of processing
units.scope: processing of the data subject's personal data
units.condition: the processing is unlawful and the data subject opposes erasure of the personal data and requests restriction of their use instead
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the restriction of processing of their personal data when the processing is unlawful and the data subject opposes erasure of the personal data and requests restriction of their use instead.

units.action: obtain from the controller the restriction of processing
units.scope: processing of the data subject's personal data
units.condition: the data subject has objected to processing pursuant to Article 21(1)
units.temporal: pending verification whether the controller's legitimate grounds override those of the data subject
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the restriction of processing of their personal data when the data subject has objected to processing pursuant to Article 21(1), pending verification whether the controller's legitimate grounds override those of the data subject.

units.action: communicate any rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing
units.scope: each recipient to whom the personal data have been disclosed
units.condition: after carrying out the rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing in accordance with Articles 16, 17(1) or 18
units.exception: unless this proves impossible or involves disproportionate effort
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to communicate any rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing to each recipient to whom the personal data have been disclosed when such measures have been carried out in accordance with Articles 16, 17(1) or 18, unless this proves impossible or involves disproportionate effort.

units.ru_label: Inform data subject of recipients on request
units.action: inform the data subject about the recipients to whom the personal data have been disclosed
units.condition: if the data subject requests it
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to inform the data subject about the recipients to whom the personal data have been disclosed if the data subject requests it.

units.action: receive the personal data provided by the data subject to a controller in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format
units.scope: Personal data concerning the data subject that the data subject has provided to a controller; format must be structured, commonly used and machine-readable; exercise without prejudice to Article 17
units.condition: Processing is based on consent (Article 6(1)(a) or Article 9(2)(a)) or on a contract (Article 6(1)(b)); and the processing is carried out by automated means
units.exception: Does not apply to processing necessary for the performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller; and the exercise shall not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to receive the personal data they have provided to a controller in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format when the processing is based on consent or a contract and is carried out by automated means, except where the processing is necessary for a task in the public interest or under official authority and provided the exercise does not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others.

units.addressee: controller to which the personal data have been provided
units.action: hinder the data subject’s transmission of those data to another controller
units.scope: Controller to which the personal data have been provided; conduct that would obstruct the data subject’s transmission; exercise without prejudice to Article 17
units.condition: The data subject seeks to transmit those data under Article 20(1) (processing based on consent or contract and carried out by automated means)
units.exception: Prohibition does not apply where the right to data portability does not apply due to processing necessary for a task in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority, or where the exercise would adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others
units.proposition: The controller to which the personal data have been provided is prohibited from hindering the data subject’s transmission of those data to another controller when the data subject exercises the right to data portability under Article 20(1), except where that right does not apply due to public-interest or official-authority processing or where the exercise would adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others.

units.action: have the personal data transmitted directly from one controller to another
units.scope: In exercising the right to data portability under Article 20(1); direct controller-to-controller transfer; exercise without prejudice to Article 17
units.condition: Technically feasible; and the data subject is exercising the right to data portability under Article 20(1) (processing based on consent or contract and carried out by automated means)
units.exception: Does not apply to processing necessary for the performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller; and the exercise shall not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to have the personal data transmitted directly from one controller to another, where technically feasible, when exercising the right to data portability under Article 20(1), except where the processing is necessary for a task in the public interest or under official authority and provided the exercise does not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others.

units.action: object to processing of personal data concerning him or her
units.scope: processing based on point (e) or (f) of Article 6(1), including profiling based on those provisions
units.condition: on grounds relating to the data subject's particular situation
units.proposition: The data subject has the right to object, on grounds relating to his or her particular situation, at any time to processing of personal data concerning him or her that is based on Article 6(1)(e) or (f), including profiling based on those provisions.

units.action: object to processing of personal data concerning him or her for direct marketing
units.scope: processing for direct marketing purposes, including profiling to the extent related to such direct marketing
units.condition: where personal data are processed for direct marketing purposes
units.proposition: Where personal data are processed for direct marketing purposes, the data subject has the right to object at any time to processing of personal data concerning him or her for such marketing, including profiling to the extent that it is related to such direct marketing.

units.action: process the personal data for direct marketing purposes
units.scope: processing for direct marketing purposes
units.condition: where the data subject objects to processing for direct marketing purposes
units.proposition: Where the data subject objects to processing for direct marketing purposes, the controller shall no longer process the personal data for such purposes.

units.ru_label: DS right not to be subject to solely automated decisions
units.action: not be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal effects concerning the data subject or similarly significantly affects the data subject
units.exception: if the decision is necessary for entering into or performing a contract between the data subject and a controller; or is authorised by Union or Member State law that lays down suitable measures to safeguard the data subject's rights and freedoms and legitimate interests; or is based on the data subject's explicit consent
units.proposition: The data subject has the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produces legal effects concerning them or similarly significantly affects them, except where the decision is necessary for a contract, is authorised by Union or Member State law that lays down suitable safeguards, or is based on the data subject's explicit consent.

units.ru_label: Controller must implement suitable safeguards in 22(2)(a),(c) cases
units.action: implement suitable measures to safeguard the data subject's rights and freedoms and legitimate interests
units.scope: decisions permitted under Article 22(2)(a) or 22(2)(c)
units.proposition: Where a decision falling under Article 22(2)(a) or 22(2)(c) is taken, the controller shall implement suitable measures to safeguard the data subject's rights and freedoms and legitimate interests.

units.ru_label: DS right to human intervention in 22(2)(a),(c) cases
units.action: obtain human intervention on the part of the controller
units.scope: decisions permitted under Article 22(2)(a) or 22(2)(c)
units.proposition: In decisions permitted under Article 22(2)(a) or 22(2)(c), the data subject has the right to obtain human intervention on the part of the controller.

units.action: restrict, by legislative measure, the scope of the obligations and rights in Articles 12 to 22 and 34, and of Article 5 insofar as its provisions correspond to Articles 12 to 22
units.scope: laws to which controllers or processors are subject
units.condition: only if the restriction respects the essence of fundamental rights and freedoms and is necessary and proportionate in a democratic society to safeguard one or more of: national security; defence; public security; the prevention, investigation, detection or prosecution of criminal offences or the execution of criminal penalties, including safeguarding against and preventing threats to public security; other important objectives of general public interest of the Union or of a Member State, in particular important economic or financial interests of the Union or of a Member State, including monetary, budgetary and taxation matters, public health and social security; the protection of judicial independence and judicial proceedings; the prevention, investigation, detection and prosecution of breaches of ethics for regulated professions; a monitoring, inspection or regulatory function connected, even occasionally, to the exercise of official authority in the cases referred to in points (a) to (e) and (g); the protection of the data subject or the rights and freedoms of others; or the enforcement of civil law claims
units.proposition: A Union or Member State legislator has the power to restrict, by legislative measure, the scope of the obligations and rights in Articles 12 to 22 and 34, and of Article 5 insofar as it corresponds to Articles 12 to 22, in laws to which controllers or processors are subject, only if the restriction respects the essence of fundamental rights and freedoms and is necessary and proportionate in a democratic society to safeguard specified public interests.

units.action: ensure the legislative measure contains specific provisions as to the purposes of the processing or categories of processing
units.scope: any legislative measure adopted under Article 23(1)
units.condition: where relevant
units.proposition: A Union or Member State legislator is obliged, where relevant, to ensure any legislative measure adopted under Article 23(1) contains specific provisions as to the purposes of the processing or categories of processing.

units.action: ensure the legislative measure contains specific provisions as to the categories of personal data
units.scope: any legislative measure adopted under Article 23(1)
units.condition: where relevant
units.proposition: A Union or Member State legislator is obliged, where relevant, to ensure any legislative measure adopted under Article 23(1) contains specific provisions as to the categories of personal data.

units.action: implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure and to be able to demonstrate that processing is performed in accordance with this Regulation
units.scope: processing under the controller’s responsibility
units.condition: taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing and the risks of varying likelihood and severity for the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.proposition: The controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing and the risks to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, to ensure and to be able to demonstrate that processing under its responsibility is performed in accordance with this Regulation.

units.action: review the measures referred to in Article 24(1)
units.scope: technical and organisational measures implemented under Article 24(1)
units.condition: where necessary
units.proposition: The controller shall review the measures referred to in Article 24(1) where necessary.

units.ru_label: Implement data protection policies when proportionate
units.action: implement appropriate data protection policies as part of the measures referred to in Article 24(1)
units.scope: measures established under Article 24(1)
units.condition: where proportionate in relation to processing activities
units.proposition: Where proportionate in relation to processing activities, the controller shall implement appropriate data protection policies as part of the measures referred to in Article 24(1).

units.action: implement appropriate technical and organisational measures for the processing
units.scope: measures may include pseudonymisation and aim to meet GDPR requirements and protect data subjects’ rights
units.condition: taking into account the state of the art, the cost of implementation, the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing, and the risks of varying likelihood and severity for rights and freedoms of natural persons posed by the processing
units.temporal: both at the time of the determination of the means for processing and at the time of the processing itself
units.proposition: The controller shall, taking into account specified technological, economic, contextual and risk factors, implement appropriate technical and organisational measures for the processing at both the design and operational stages.

units.action: design the technical and organisational measures to implement data-protection principles effectively
units.scope: data-protection principles include, for example, data minimisation
units.condition: as part of implementing measures under Article 25(1)
units.temporal: both at the time of the determination of the means for processing and at the time of the processing itself
units.proposition: The controller shall design the technical and organisational measures so that they implement data-protection principles effectively.

units.action: integrate the necessary safeguards into the processing
units.scope: safeguards necessary to meet the requirements of the GDPR and protect the rights of data subjects
units.condition: as part of implementing measures under Article 25(1)
units.temporal: both at the time of the determination of the means for processing and at the time of the processing itself
units.proposition: The controller shall integrate the necessary safeguards into the processing.

units.action: determine their respective responsibilities for compliance with this Regulation by means of an arrangement, in a transparent manner
units.scope: responsibilities for compliance, in particular regarding the exercising of data subject rights and duties to provide the information referred to in Articles 13 and 14
units.exception: unless and insofar as Union or Member State law to which the controllers are subject determines the respective responsibilities
units.proposition: Joint controllers must, in a transparent manner and by means of an arrangement between them, determine their respective responsibilities for compliance with this Regulation, in particular regarding the exercising of data subject rights and duties to provide the information referred to in Articles 13 and 14, unless and insofar as Union or Member State law to which they are subject determines those responsibilities.

units.action: designate in the arrangement a contact point for data subjects
units.scope: the arrangement between the joint controllers
units.proposition: Joint controllers may designate in their arrangement a contact point for data subjects.

units.action: ensure the arrangement duly reflects the respective roles and relationships of the joint controllers vis-à-vis the data subjects
units.scope: the arrangement referred to in Article 26(1)
units.proposition: Joint controllers must ensure that the arrangement duly reflects their respective roles and relationships vis-à-vis data subjects.

units.addressee: controller or processor to whom Article 3(2) GDPR applies
units.action: designate in writing a representative established in the Union
units.scope: representation for processing activities to which Article 3(2) applies
units.condition: Where Article 3(2) GDPR applies
units.exception: Does not apply where (a) the processing is occasional, does not include large-scale processing of special categories of data referred to in Article 9(1) or of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences referred to in Article 10, and is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons (taking into account the nature, context, scope and purposes of the processing); or (b) the controller or processor is a public authority or body.
units.proposition: Where Article 3(2) applies, a controller or processor shall designate in writing a representative in the Union, unless the processing is occasional, does not include large-scale processing of special categories of data or of data on criminal convictions and offences, and is unlikely to result in a risk to natural persons' rights and freedoms, or the controller or processor is a public authority or body.

units.action: be established in one of the Member States where the relevant data subjects are located
units.scope: data subjects whose personal data are processed in relation to the offering of goods or services to them, or whose behaviour is monitored
units.condition: When a representative is designated under Article 27(1)
units.proposition: A representative designated under Article 27 shall be established in one of the Member States where the data subjects concerned are located, namely those offered goods or services or whose behaviour is monitored.

units.addressee: controller or processor that designates a representative
units.action: mandate the representative to be addressed, in addition to or instead of the controller or the processor, by supervisory authorities and data subjects on all issues related to processing for the purposes of ensuring compliance with the GDPR
units.scope: all issues related to processing; for the purposes of ensuring compliance with the GDPR
units.condition: When a representative is designated under Article 27(1)
units.proposition: The controller or processor shall mandate the representative to be addressable, in addition to or instead of the controller or processor, by supervisory authorities and data subjects on all issues related to processing for the purpose of ensuring compliance with the GDPR.

units.action: use only processors that provide sufficient guarantees to implement appropriate technical and organisational measures so that processing meets this Regulation and protects data subjects' rights
units.scope: selection and engagement of processors
units.condition: where processing is to be carried out on behalf of a controller
units.proposition: Where processing is to be carried out on behalf of a controller, the controller is obliged to use only processors that provide sufficient guarantees to implement appropriate technical and organisational measures such that processing meets this Regulation and protects data subjects’ rights.

units.action: engage another processor
units.scope: sub-processing
units.exception: prior specific or general written authorisation of the controller
units.proposition: A processor is prohibited from engaging another processor without prior specific or general written authorisation of the controller.

units.action: inform the controller of any intended changes concerning the addition or replacement of other processors
units.scope: sub-processing
units.condition: where the controller has given general written authorisation to engage other processors
units.proposition: Where the controller has given general written authorisation, the processor is obliged to inform the controller of any intended changes concerning the addition or replacement of other processors before implementing the changes.

units.action: process personal data
units.scope: personal data to which the processor has access
units.exception: when acting on instructions from the controller; or when required to process by Union or Member State law
units.proposition: The processor shall not process personal data to which it has access except on the controller's instructions, unless Union or Member State law requires the processing.

units.action: maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility
units.scope: processing activities under the controller's responsibility
units.exception: shall not apply to an enterprise or an organisation employing fewer than 250 persons unless the processing it carries out is likely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, the processing is not occasional, or the processing includes special categories of data as referred to in
units.proposition: The controller shall maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility.

units.action: include the name and contact details of the controller in the record
units.scope: the record of processing activities maintained under Article 30(1)
units.proposition: The controller shall include in the record the name and contact details of the controller.

units.action: include the name and contact details of the joint controller in the record
units.scope: the record of processing activities maintained under Article 30(1)
units.condition: where applicable (a joint controller exists)
units.proposition: Where applicable, the controller shall include in the record the name and contact details of the joint controller.

units.ru_label: Controller cooperate with SA on request
units.action: cooperate with the supervisory authority
units.scope: in the performance of the supervisory authority's tasks
units.condition: on request by the supervisory authority
units.proposition: The controller shall, on request, cooperate with the supervisory authority in the performance of its tasks.

units.ru_label: Processor cooperate with SA on request
units.action: cooperate with the supervisory authority
units.scope: in the performance of the supervisory authority's tasks
units.condition: on request by the supervisory authority
units.proposition: The processor shall, on request, cooperate with the supervisory authority in the performance of its tasks.

units.action: implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk
units.scope: processing of personal data
units.condition: taking into account the state of the art, implementation costs, and the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing, as well as risks of varying likelihood and severity to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.proposition: The controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, taking into account specified factors, to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

units.action: implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk
units.scope: processing of personal data
units.condition: taking into account the state of the art, implementation costs, and the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing, as well as risks of varying likelihood and severity to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.proposition: The processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, taking into account specified factors, to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

units.action: include pseudonymisation in the implemented security measures
units.scope: personal data processed
units.condition: as appropriate to the risk
units.proposition: The controller shall, as appropriate, include pseudonymisation in the implemented security measures.

units.action: notify the competent supervisory authority of the personal data breach
units.scope: to the supervisory authority competent in accordance with Article 55
units.condition: in the case of a personal data breach
units.exception: unless the personal data breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.temporal: without undue delay after becoming aware of the personal data breach
units.proposition: The controller shall, in the case of a personal data breach, notify the competent supervisory authority without undue delay after becoming aware of the breach, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons.

units.action: notify the competent supervisory authority of the personal data breach
units.scope: to the supervisory authority competent in accordance with Article 55
units.condition: in the case of a personal data breach and where feasible
units.exception: unless the personal data breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.temporal: not later than 72 hours after becoming aware of the personal data breach
units.proposition: Where feasible, the controller shall notify the competent supervisory authority not later than 72 hours after becoming aware of a personal data breach, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons.

units.action: accompany the notification to the supervisory authority with reasons for the delay
units.scope: notification under Article 33(1)
units.condition: where the notification to the supervisory authority is not made within 72 hours
units.temporal: at the time of the late notification
units.proposition: Where the notification to the supervisory authority is not made within 72 hours, the controller shall accompany the notification with reasons for the delay.

units.action: communicate the personal data breach to the data subject
units.scope: communication of personal data breaches to data subjects
units.condition: a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons
units.exception: communication is not required if: (a) appropriate technical and organisational protection measures were implemented and applied to the affected personal data (e.g., encryption rendering data unintelligible to unauthorised persons); (b) subsequent measures ensure the high risk is no longer likely to materialise; or (c) individual communication would involve disproportionate effort
units.proposition: When a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall communicate the personal data breach to the data subject without undue delay, unless an exception in Article 34(3) applies.

units.action: describe in clear and plain language the nature of the personal data breach in the communication
units.scope: content of the communication to data subjects under Article 34(1)
units.condition: when communicating a personal data breach to data subjects pursuant to Article 34(1)
units.proposition: When communicating a personal data breach to the data subject pursuant to Article 34(1), the controller shall describe in clear and plain language the nature of the personal data breach.

units.action: include at least the information and measures referred to in Article 33(3)(b), (c) and (d) in the communication
units.scope: content of the communication to data subjects under Article 34(1)
units.condition: when communicating a personal data breach to data subjects pursuant to Article 34(1)
units.proposition: When communicating a personal data breach to the data subject pursuant to Article 34(1), the controller shall include at least the information and measures referred to in points (b), (c) and (d) of Article 33(3).

units.action: give advice
units.scope: on the processing operations referred to in Article 36(2)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall give advice on the processing operations referred to in Article 36(2).

units.action: encourage the drawing up of codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 40(1)
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall encourage the drawing up of codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40(1).

units.action: approve codes of conduct
units.scope: pursuant to Article 40(5)
units.condition: where the codes of conduct provide sufficient safeguards
units.proposition: Each supervisory authority shall approve codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40(5) where the codes provide sufficient safeguards.

units.action: consult the supervisory authority
units.scope: intended processing
units.condition: where a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 indicates the processing would result in a high risk in the absence of measures taken by the controller to mitigate the risk
units.proposition: The controller must consult the supervisory authority before processing when a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 indicates that the processing would result in a high risk absent mitigating measures.

units.ru_label: SA must advise when intended processing would infringe
units.action: provide written advice to the controller and, where applicable, the processor
units.scope: intended processing referred to in paragraph 1
units.condition: where the supervisory authority is of the opinion that the intended processing would infringe the GDPR, in particular where the controller has insufficiently identified or mitigated the risk
units.temporal: within up to eight weeks of receipt of the request for consultation
units.proposition: Where it considers the intended processing referred to in paragraph 1 would infringe the GDPR, the supervisory authority must provide written advice to the controller and, where applicable, the processor within up to eight weeks of receiving the consultation request.

units.ru_label: SA may use Article 58 powers in consultation
units.action: use any of its powers referred to in Article 58
units.scope: intended processing referred to in paragraph 1
units.condition: where the supervisory authority is of the opinion that the intended processing would infringe the GDPR
units.proposition: Where it considers the intended processing referred to in paragraph 1 would infringe the GDPR, the supervisory authority may use any of its powers referred to in Article 58.

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: if any of the following apply: (a) processing is carried out by a public authority or body; (b) the controller’s core activities consist of processing operations that, by virtue of their nature, scope and/or purposes, require regular and systematic monitoring of data subjects on a large scale; or (c) the controller’s core activities consist of large-scale processing of special categories of data under Article 9 and personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences under Article 10
units.exception: for point (a), except for courts acting in their judicial capacity
units.proposition: The controller is obligated to designate a data protection officer when any trigger in Article 37(1)(a)–(c) applies, except that courts acting in their judicial capacity are excluded from point (a).

units.action: designate a data protection officer
units.condition: if any of the following apply: (a) processing is carried out by a public authority or body; (b) the processor’s core activities consist of processing operations that, by virtue of their nature, scope and/or purposes, require regular and systematic monitoring of data subjects on a large scale; or (c) the processor’s core activities consist of large-scale processing of special categories of data under Article 9 and personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences under Article 10
units.exception: for point (a), except for courts acting in their judicial capacity
units.proposition: The processor is obligated to designate a data protection officer when any trigger in Article 37(1)(a)–(c) applies, except that courts acting in their judicial capacity are excluded from point (a).

units.action: appoint a single data protection officer for the group
units.condition: provided that a data protection officer is easily accessible from each establishment
units.proposition: A group of undertakings is permitted to appoint a single data protection officer for the group, provided that the data protection officer is easily accessible from each establishment.

units.action: ensure that the data protection officer is properly involved in issues relating to the protection of personal data
units.scope: all issues relating to the protection of personal data
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to ensure that the data protection officer is properly and timely involved in all issues relating to the protection of personal data.

units.action: ensure that the data protection officer is properly involved in issues relating to the protection of personal data
units.scope: all issues relating to the protection of personal data
units.proposition: The processor is obliged to ensure that the data protection officer is properly and timely involved in all issues relating to the protection of personal data.

units.ru_label: Provide resources for DPO tasks - controller
units.action: provide the resources necessary for the data protection officer to carry out the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.scope: supporting the data protection officer in performing the tasks referred to in Article 39
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to provide the resources necessary for the data protection officer to carry out the tasks referred to in Article 39.

units.action: inform the controller or the processor and the employees who carry out processing of their data protection obligations
units.scope: obligations under the GDPR and other Union or Member State data protection provisions
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged to inform the controller or the processor and the employees who carry out processing of their obligations under the GDPR and other Union or Member State data protection provisions.

units.action: monitor compliance with legal and internal data protection requirements
units.scope: GDPR, other Union or Member State data protection provisions, and the controller’s or processor’s policies on personal data protection, including the assignment of responsibilities, awareness-raising and training of staff involved in processing operations, and related audits
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged to monitor compliance with the GDPR, with other Union or Member State data protection provisions, and with the controller’s or processor’s policies on personal data protection, including the assignment of responsibilities, awareness-raising and training of staff involved in processing operations, and the related audits.

units.action: provide advice as regards the data protection impact assessment
units.scope: the data protection impact assessment (DPIA)
units.condition: where requested
units.proposition: The data protection officer is obliged, where requested, to provide advice as regards the data protection impact assessment.

units.addressee: Member States; supervisory authorities; the European Data Protection Board; the European Commission
units.action: encourage the drawing up of codes of conduct intended to contribute to the proper application of the Regulation
units.scope: Taking account of the specific features of the various processing sectors and the specific needs of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises
units.proposition: Member States, supervisory authorities, the Board and the Commission are obliged to encourage the drawing up of codes of conduct that contribute to the proper application of the GDPR, taking account of sectoral features and the needs of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises.

units.addressee: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors
units.action: prepare codes of conduct to specify the application of the Regulation
units.scope: Topics may include: fair and transparent processing; legitimate interests in specific contexts; collection of personal data; pseudonymisation; information to the public and data subjects; exercise of data subjects’ rights; information provided to and protection of children and obtaining parental consent; measures and procedures under Articles 24 and 25 and security measures under Article 32; breach notification to supervisory authorities and communication to data subjects; transfers to third countries or international organisations; and out-of-court and other dispute resolution procedures between controllers and data subjects
units.exception: Without prejudice to data subjects’ rights under Articles 77 and 79
units.proposition: Associations and other bodies representing categories of controllers or processors are permitted to prepare codes of conduct to specify the application of the GDPR on the listed topics, without prejudice to data subjects’ rights under Articles 77 and 79.

units.addressee: Controllers or processors not subject to the Regulation pursuant to Article 3
units.action: adhere to approved and generally valid codes of conduct
units.scope: To provide appropriate safeguards for personal data transfers to third countries or international organisations under Article 46(2)(e)
units.condition: The code of conduct is approved pursuant to paragraph 5 and has general validity pursuant to paragraph 9
units.proposition: Controllers or processors not subject to the GDPR are permitted to adhere to codes of conduct approved under paragraph 5 and having general validity under paragraph 9 to provide appropriate safeguards for transfers under Article 46(2)(e).

units.addressee: body with appropriate expertise accredited by the competent supervisory authority
units.action: carry out monitoring of compliance with a code of conduct
units.scope: codes of conduct pursuant to Article 40
units.condition: the body has an appropriate level of expertise in relation to the subject-matter of the code and is accredited for that purpose by the competent supervisory authority
units.exception: without prejudice to the tasks and powers of the competent supervisory authority under Articles 57 and 58; this Article does not apply to processing carried out by public authorities and bodies
units.proposition: An accredited body with appropriate expertise may carry out monitoring of compliance with a code of conduct pursuant to Article 40.

units.action: accredit a body to monitor compliance with a code of conduct
units.scope: accreditation of a body referred to in Article 41(1)
units.condition: the body has demonstrated its independence and expertise to the satisfaction of the competent supervisory authority; has established procedures to assess controllers' and processors' eligibility to apply the code, to monitor their compliance with its provisions, and to periodically review its operation; has established procedures and structures to handle complaints about infringements or implementation of the code and made them transparent to data subjects and the public; and has demonstrated to the satisfaction of the competent supervisory authority that its tasks and duties do not result in a conflict of interests
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority has the power to accredit a body to monitor compliance with a code of conduct when the body meets the criteria in Article 41(2)(a)–(d).

units.action: submit the draft criteria for accreditation of a monitoring body to the Board
units.scope: consistency mechanism under Article 63 for accreditation criteria of bodies referred to in Article 41(1)
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority shall submit the draft criteria for accreditation of a body referred to in Article 41(1) to the Board pursuant to Article 63.

units.action: impose a total administrative fine that exceeds the amount specified for the gravest infringement
units.scope: administrative fines under this Regulation
units.condition: where a controller or processor intentionally or negligently infringes several provisions of this Regulation for the same or linked processing operations
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose a total administrative fine that exceeds the amount specified for the gravest infringement where a controller or processor intentionally or negligently infringes several provisions of this Regulation for the same or linked processing operations.

units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 10 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for infringements of the obligations of the controller and the processor pursuant to Articles 8, 11, 25 to 39, 42 and 43
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 10 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for infringements of the obligations of the controller and the processor pursuant to Articles 8, 11, 25 to 39, 42 and 43.

units.ru_label: Cap fines 20m/4% for data subject rights
units.action: impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year
units.scope: in accordance with paragraph 2
units.condition: for infringements of the data subjects' rights pursuant to Articles 12 to 22
units.proposition: The supervisory authority shall not impose an administrative fine exceeding the higher of 20 000 000 EUR or, in the case of an undertaking, 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year for infringements of the data subjects' rights pursuant to Articles 12 to 22.

units.action: issue an opinion on the matter submitted to it
units.scope: consistency mechanism matters
units.condition: a competent supervisory authority intends to adopt a decision that aims to determine standard data protection clauses under Article 46(2)(d) and Article 28(8), or to authorise contractual clauses under Article 46(3)(a), or to approve binding corporate rules under Article 47, or a request under paragraph 2 has been made
units.exception: where the Board has already issued an opinion on the same matter
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall issue an opinion on the matter submitted to it in the cases listed in paragraph 1(d)–(f) or upon a request under paragraph 2, unless it has already issued an opinion on the same matter.

units.action: adopt the opinion by simple majority of its members
units.scope: opinion under this Article
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board shall adopt the opinion by simple majority of its members within eight weeks.

units.action: extend the opinion-adoption period by up to six weeks
units.scope: the eight-week period for adopting the opinion
units.condition: taking into account the complexity of the subject matter
units.proposition: The European Data Protection Board may extend the eight-week period for adopting the opinion by up to six weeks, taking into account the complexity of the subject matter.

units.ru_label: No transfer by controller without Chapter V compliance
units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or to an international organisation, including onward transfers
units.scope: personal data that are undergoing processing or are intended for processing after transfer; includes onward transfers from the third country or international organisation to another third country or international organisation
units.condition: subject to the other provisions of the GDPR
units.exception: when the conditions laid down in Chapter V are complied with
units.proposition: The controller is prohibited from transferring personal data to a third country or to an international organisation, including onward transfers, unless the conditions laid down in Chapter V are complied with, subject to the other provisions of the GDPR.

units.ru_label: No transfer by processor without Chapter V compliance
units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or to an international organisation, including onward transfers
units.scope: personal data that are undergoing processing or are intended for processing after transfer; includes onward transfers from the third country or international organisation to another third country or international organisation
units.condition: subject to the other provisions of the GDPR
units.exception: when the conditions laid down in Chapter V are complied with
units.proposition: The processor is prohibited from transferring personal data to a third country or to an international organisation, including onward transfers, unless the conditions laid down in Chapter V are complied with, subject to the other provisions of the GDPR.

units.ru_label: Controller must apply Chapter V to maintain protection
units.action: apply all provisions in Chapter V
units.scope: in a manner that ensures the level of protection of natural persons guaranteed by the GDPR is not undermined
units.proposition: The controller is obliged to apply all provisions in Chapter V so as to ensure that the level of protection of natural persons guaranteed by the GDPR is not undermined.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation on the basis of an adequacy decision
units.scope: international transfers of personal data under Article 45
units.condition: the European Commission has decided that the destination ensures an adequate level of protection
units.proposition: A controller or processor may transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation where the Commission has decided that the destination ensures an adequate level of protection.

units.action: require any specific authorisation for a transfer based on an adequacy decision
units.scope: transfers of personal data permitted under Article 45(1)
units.condition: the transfer is based on a Commission adequacy decision
units.proposition: A supervisory authority is prohibited from requiring any specific authorisation for a transfer of personal data that is based on a Commission adequacy decision under Article 45.

units.action: take account of the factors listed in point (a) when assessing adequacy
units.scope: assessment of adequacy of the level of protection in a third country, territory, sector, or international organisation
units.condition: when assessing the adequacy of the level of protection
units.proposition: When assessing the adequacy of the level of protection, the European Commission shall take account of the rule of law, respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms, relevant legislation and its implementation, data protection and professional rules, security measures including onward transfer rules, case-law, and the effectiveness of data subject rights and administrative and judicial redress in the destination.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: when none of the derogations in points (a)–(g) of paragraph 1 applies and the conditions for the compelling legitimate interests derogation in paragraph 1 second subparagraph are not fulfilled
units.proposition: The controller or processor is prohibited from transferring personal data to a third country or an international organisation unless one of the derogations in points (a)–(g) applies or the conditions for the compelling legitimate interests derogation in paragraph 1 second subparagraph are fulfilled.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the data subject has explicitly consented to the proposed transfer after being informed of the possible risks of such transfers due to the absence of an adequacy decision and appropriate safeguards
units.exception: does not apply to activities carried out by public authorities in the exercise of their public powers
units.proposition: The controller or processor is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation when the data subject has explicitly consented to the proposed transfer after being informed of the possible risks due to the absence of an adequacy decision and appropriate safeguards, except where the transfer is carried out by a public authority in the exercise of its public powers.

units.action: transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.scope: transfers of personal data to a third country or an international organisation
units.condition: the transfer is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims
units.proposition: The controller or processor is permitted to transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation when the transfer is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

units.action: approve binding corporate rules in accordance with the consistency mechanism set out in Article 63
units.scope: approval of binding corporate rules
units.condition: provided that the binding corporate rules are legally binding and apply to and are enforced by every concerned member of the group, including their employees; expressly confer enforceable rights on data subjects regarding the processing of their personal data; and fulfil the requirements in Article 47(2)
units.proposition: The competent supervisory authority is obliged to approve binding corporate rules in accordance with the Article 63 consistency mechanism if the rules are legally binding, apply to and are enforced by every concerned group member including employees, confer enforceable rights on data subjects, and fulfil the requirements in Article 47(2).

units.addressee: controller or processor adopting binding corporate rules
units.action: specify the structure and contact details of the group and of each of its members
